newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Bescorp in Indian power deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Bescorp in Indian power deal.

text.p: Malaysia's Bescorp Industries Bhd said on Thursday it was poised to enter a joint-venture agreement to build a thermal power plant in Dharwad, India.
Parties involved in the construction of the 300 megawatt plant were finalising the deal, Bescorp said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
It added that it will make a detailed announcement to the exchange in another "five market days".
Shares of Bescorp have been voluntarily suspended since January 23, when they closed at 24.20 ringgit.
